test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneously spelt word is '**Presision**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given Options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Presision**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Precision**'. • It means 'the quality of being clear or exact'. (स्‍पष्‍ट या यथार्थ होने का गुण; स्‍पष्‍टता या यथार्थता) • *Example: The plans were drawn with great **precision**.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.** **Correct Answer:**__ *Presision.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Participation**: the action of taking part in something. सहभागिता, भागीदारी • **Predominant**: most noticeable, powerful or important. सबसे अधिक दिखाई पड़ने वाला, स्‍पष्‍टतया दर्शनीय, सशक्त या महत्वपूर्ण • **Permanent**: lasting for a long time or forever; that will not change. देर तक या सदा के लिए रहने वाला, स्‍थायी; अपरिवर्तित, जो न बदले 3a:Tc09, The correct answer is '**Intensify**'.
